name: Nineties Memphis Pitch
tagline: Playful 90s pitch deck with cream paper, serif headlines, hand-drawn arrows, checkerboards, stickers, saturated blocks, and photo collage layouts.

palette.description: Cream paper base with black ink, hot pink, teal, yellow, coral, and green Memphis accents.

typography.style: Bold vintage serif headlines with clean rounded sans body text.

best_for: Creative pitches, education decks, culture campaigns, youth programs, team stories, and informal product narratives.
avoid_for: Board updates, legal decks, clinical reports, or technical architecture reviews where retro decoration would reduce trust.

source_inspiration.name: SlidesCarnival Illustrative Creative 90's Style Presentation
source_inspiration.notes: Independent high-fidelity HTML/CSS reconstruction based on public preview thumbnails: cream paper, serif headline, hand-drawn arrows, checkerboards, sticker geometry, and framed images. No source assets are embedded.
